title: Deliveries
line: What the agents have finished and how far each commit has got
hint: Deliveries that have not arrived yet
queueLine: What went through harbard deliver and integrate: the automatic queue that checks a commit and moves the branch.
untrackedNoCommit: Names no commit: there's nothing to integrate.
untrackedUnknownCommit: harbard can't find this commit in the repository.
installedUnknown: serve doesn't say which commit it runs, so there's no way to know what's installed.
installedSame: You have commit {commit} installed (serve and console).
installedMismatch: serve runs commit {serve} and the console runs {console}: reload the console after installing.
landedAsTitle: Reached main as {sha}, with the same change
verifiedTitle: harbard integrate built this commit on top of the tip, passed the checks and moved the branch
emptyTitle: No agent has finished anything yet
emptyHint: A delivery appears when an agent writes DONE.
restTitle: Up to date or no commit to track ({count})
